settings.name: RiseFramework
settings.description: The entities of the RISE framework 2.3.0 (llms-rise-framework.txt) and how they relate: what each phase leaves in a topic folder, the system of drawings, and the capability a system draws.
settings.notes: Drawn 2026-11-26 from llms-rise-framework.txt 2.3.0, at Guillaume's ask: the framework's entities and relationships, kept in the repository so a person and an agent can discuss and navigate them. Drawing.role and Drawing.executed are proposed (jgwill/smcraft#35), the decision-model kind is proposed (jgwill/smcraft#32), Capability kind plugin is proposed (jgwill/medicine-wheel#181). Held for 3.0.0: D1 to D4 of jgwill/llms-txt#48.

entities.name: Repository
entities.description: A GitHub repository that holds code, specifications and capabilities.

entities.name: Prototype
entities.description: The working code Phase 1 reads: what it does and what people love in it.

entities.name: Topic
entities.description: One rispecs/<topic>/ folder, one surface. Holds every file the phases leave.

entities.name: ReverseEngineering
entities.description: 1 R. 01-reverse-engineer.md: what the prototype does, observed. May live in an episode vessel; the topic README says where.

entities.name: Intent
entities.description: 2 I. 02-intent.md: desired outcome, current reality, beloved qualities, the tension.

entities.name: KinFile
entities.description: 2 I. <topic>.kin.md or <part>.kin.md: the relatives of the spec and what each relationship asks of us.

entities.name: KinRelation
entities.description: One relative in a kin file and the kind of relationship. Relationality as in llms-relationality.md, not a database relation.

attributes.name: relative
attributes.description: a file, package, repository, person or episode

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: came from | we rely on | relies on us | walks beside | holds a decision

attributes.name: asks
attributes.description: what the relationship asks of the agent

entities.name: Specification
entities.description: 3 S. Prose code another LLM can implement: SPEC.md (master), NN-<part>.spec.md, <topic>.spec.md or NN-<part>.rispec.md.

entities.name: CreativeAdvancementScenario
entities.description: A usage scenario in place of BDD: Desired Outcome, Current Reality, Natural Progression, Resolution.

attributes.name: sequence
attributes.description: the sequence drawing that backs it, when there is one (jgwill/llms-txt#44)

entities.name: System
entities.description: 3 S since 2.3.0. <topic>.sysdf.json: lists the drawings that belong together. One per topic.

entities.name: Drawing
entities.description: 3 S since 2.3.0. A member of a system: an ERD (.erdf.json), a state machine (.smdf.json), a sequence (.sqdf.json), a decision model (.dmdf.json, proposed).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: proposed, jgwill/smcraft#35: unique in the system, what a person calls it

attributes.name: executed
attributes.description: proposed, jgwill/smcraft#35: the Factory runs it, so the drawing is the definition

entities.name: Capability
entities.description: What a repository can do: a row of .miadi/capabilities.jsonl, addressed miadi-capability://<owner>/<repo>/<kind>/<name>.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: package | cli | skill | decision | app; plugin proposed (jgwill/medicine-wheel#181)

entities.name: Export
entities.description: 4 E. NN-export.md: how an implementer, a harness or an episode takes the spec up.

entities.name: Episode
entities.description: A Chronicle episode, miadi-chronicle://<n>. Its episode.yaml lists the rispecs it holds.

entities.name: Status
entities.description: ↺ Return. STATUS.md: what is built and what is not yet, kept true as the code moves on.
